perks.name: Bewildering Burst
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a disorienting blast.

enhanced.name: Bewildering Burst
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a longer-lasting disorienting blast.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.description: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

enhanced.name: Gutshot Straight
enhanced.description: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage but decreases target acquisition slightly.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.description: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

enhanced.name: Outlaw
enhanced.description: Precision final blows greatly decrease reload time for an improved duration.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights.

enhanced.name: Snapshot Sights
enhanced.description: Faster time to aim down sights. Stability is increased.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.description: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

enhanced.name: Lone Wolf
enhanced.description: Improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.description: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Moving Target
enhanced.description: Increased movement speed and improved target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

enhanced.name: No Distractions
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for a very short period of time reduces flinch.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Mulligan
perks.description: Missing a shot has a chance to return ammo directly to the magazine.

enhanced.name: Mulligan
enhanced.description: Missing a shot has an improved chance to return ammo directly to the magazine.

perks.name: Ancillary Ordinance
perks.description: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. Multiple missiles can be prepared.

enhanced.name: Ancillary Ordinance
enhanced.description: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. More missiles can be prepared.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

enhanced.name: Box Breathing
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for an improved short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

enhanced.name: Aggregate Charge
enhanced.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target. Damage bonus is increased.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

enhanced.name: Auto-Loading Holster
enhanced.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after an improved short period of time.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

enhanced.name: Ambitious Assassin
enhanced.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.
